established_agrees.detail: Both endpoint validators succeed for actual deterministic Noise session; handshake hash/community/peer identities and crossed send/receive keys agree natively. The production theorem remains conditional on sodium.suite.Good; its universally quantified AEAD law is false for malformed key bytes (Contracts.noiseBadKey). No universal crypto assumption is discharged.

open_seal.detail: Valid 32-byte session ID/key and 24-byte nonce roundtrip actual signed message bytes natively. The theorem requires universal frame AEAD correctness/length over arbitrary key and nonce bytes; empty-key native counterexamples frameDecryptFalse/frameSizeFalse refute those unqualified premises. Finite dimensions checked; no universal crypto assumption discharged.

openFrame_auth.detail: Actual real-crypto Noise session and XChaCha frame carrying signed Bob message bytes. Successful open is certified against held session receive key. One-byte ciphertext corruption proves the universal rejection premise by exact header/key lookup equalities and failed decryption, then applies sealed_auth. Wrong directional key and modified session header also reject; damaged frame emits no sends/drops/stores and preserves held database/log.
